subject: Mathematics
source_key_points: In each of the following, there are two groups of numbers.
Look carefully at the numbers in each group and their sums.
Interchange pairs of numbers between the two groups to make their sums equal.
Try to do this using the least number of moves.
You could write each number on a small piece of paper.
Making Sums Equal Think what will happen to the sums if we interchange 2 and 5?
